note: Calculated Level 50 Speed for every Regulation M-C-legal Pokemon, across the common build and battle modifiers. Speed assumes max IVs (Champions has no IV slider); "Max" uses full investment. Columns follow the site table: rank (site dense rank by base speed desc), name (site display name), base, noInvest, maxPlus, max, min, scarf (Choice Scarf / +1), tailwind (Tailwind / +2), paralyzed.
